about: S07.7 (D.9): the traceability of every Block D design choice to Appendix G, with the honest strength of its evidence, the metric that lets the product's own data test it, and the recalibration log. docs/operations/BLOCK-D-RESEARCH-FOUNDATION.md is the written foundation; agent/tools/check-block-d-research.mjs enforces this registry, screens parent-facing copy for claims of proof (Block D Part 4 governance boundary) and keeps experiments off Block D tables (OD-23).

strengths.supported: consistent evidence for this design implication, though never a test of this exact mechanic
strengths.contested: a live scientific disagreement the product must not treat as settled either way
strengths.extrapolation: plausible from adjacent research, untested for a structured family money mechanic
strengths.vacuum: no controlled evidence either way; defensible as a communication device
strengths.open: a question the product's own longitudinal data may one day answer
strengths.regulatory: a legal and regulatory basis rather than a behavioural finding

D.13.metric: Allowance-Triggered Redemption Spike; Split-Ratio Engagement Quality

D.15.metric: Post-Goal Motivation Cliff; Save-Bucket Contribution Persistence

D.16.metric: Goal progress by provenance (static release gate)

D.18.metric: Denial-Reason Actionability Rate; Repeated-Denial Communication-Nudge Trigger Rate

recalibration.cadence: quarterly for the first year after release, then yearly (the same cadence as Appendices B and D and the Block D threshold log)

log.scope: Adoption of Appendix G as the authoritative basis for D.10-D.23; traceability and evidence strengths recorded
log.decision: Adopted by Engineering on the SPEC's mandate; awaiting the Pedagogical Lead's first review. No evidence in Appendix G has been superseded yet.

experiments.rule: OD-23: experiments run on adults (18+) only until Product and Legal choose wider ages (H.7); a minor's Block D data is only ever observed, through the consent-gated streams. No Block D table may carry an experiment assignment.
